s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing, variegated plaque in the axilla with recent color change
salient_findings: Enlarged and variegated plaque on the left axilla
Recent change to dark brown color
Intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells on histopathology
key_facts: Female patient in her 70s
Lesion present for 4 years
Initial presentation as a small eczematous, pink-to-brown plaque
Asymptomatic and slow growing
Recent change to dark brown color
Well-demarcated margins
No breast mass or lymphadenopathy detected
Intraepidermal neoplasm on incisional biopsy
Pagetoid cells with round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei
Positive for CK7 and EMA on immunohistochemical staining
Numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells

shortlist.label: Extramammary Paget's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells and positive CK7 and EMA staining

shortlist.label: Mammary Paget's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Pagetoid cells and positive EMA staining, although no breast mass was detected

shortlist.label: Superficial spreading melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recent color change and presence of melanocytes, but histology not typical

shortlist.label: Pagetoid dyskeratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Pagetoid cells, but less likely given the clinical presentation and immunohistochemical findings

shortlist.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Intraepidermal neoplasm, but less likely given the lack of typical histological features and immunohistochemical profile

raw.rationale: The presence of an intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells, positive staining for CK7 and EMA, and the location of the lesion in the axilla are consistent with Extramammary Paget's disease.

rejected.label: Mammary Paget's disease
rejected.why: No breast mass was detected, making this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Superficial spreading melanoma
rejected.why: The presence of pagetoid cells and positive staining for CK7 and EMA are not typical for melanoma

rejected.label: Pagetoid dyskeratosis
rejected.why: This condition is typically a benign lesion and does not match the malignant features described in the case

rejected.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The histopathological and immunohistochemical findings do not support this diagnosis
